desktop.description: Default: every desktop app owes every row unless the app declares N/A with a reason.

apple.description: Table 1-Apple is an unratified draft. Profile is supported by the data model; no Apple rows are shipped.

cli.description: A command-line tool or agent plugin with no window, no background engine and no paid tier (e.g. Legion). It owes the rows every process that runs on a user's machine needs; window, app-frame, engine-supervision, local-service, licence, entitlement, legal-UI and agent-surface rows are desktop concerns.
cli.ratifiedBy: Adrian, 2026-11-05, typed in the Legion chat (pulse chat said): "2 yes tell buggy to fix that in rk for cli tool", answering whether Legion, a command-line tool, must owe every desktop row M1-M20 (OW-05).

notOwed.M6: its owner is the desktop daemon; a CLI keeps its data under the settings state root (M10)
notOwed.M12: no licence or device binding (a paid CLI uses the desktop profile)
notOwed.M22: no agent surface of its own

ember.source: Orthic-Labs/ember#240 port to the mandatory set
ember.note: App-specific not-applicable rulings, ratified for Ember. An app declares them in rightkit-mandatory.json notApplicable with the reason given here. Free and open source apps (MIT OR Apache-2.0, no paid features, activation or signer) and apps with no daemon, no SQLite state and no restart-surviving jobs owe none of these rows.

notApplicable.M3: No engine child process and no restart-surviving jobs: exports and imports are in-process jobs on the activity stack. The ffmpeg sidecar already runs through rightkit-ffmpeg.
notApplicable.M4: No engine child process and no restart-surviving jobs: exports and imports are in-process jobs on the activity stack.
notApplicable.M6: No local service or daemon-discovered data location. The control channel and MCP are opt-in developer and agent ports.
notApplicable.M7: No local service or daemon-discovered data location. The control channel and MCP are opt-in developer and agent ports.
notApplicable.M9: No SQLite app state. Preferences are JSON through rightkit-app-settings; the photo catalog is a JSON-lines journal.
notApplicable.M12: Free and open source (MIT OR Apache-2.0): no paid features, activation or signer. rightkit-device identity is adopted. Applies to OSS apps.
notApplicable.M13: Free and open source (MIT OR Apache-2.0): no paid features, activation or signer. Applies to OSS apps.
notApplicable.M14: @rightkit/legal needs six proprietary roles and imports node:crypto, so it cannot run in a webview; @rightkit/onboarding mandates a legal step first. Ember ships @rightkit/legal-ui for its licences and notices and holds its first-run notice until its text is approved. OSS profile; the legal and onboarding owners need an OSS mode and a mode without a legal step.
notApplicable.M22: rightkit-agent-tools needs a daemon-backed app control service. Ember's agent surface is its own MCP server over engine command ids, being ported to rightkit-mcp. Applies to non-daemon apps.

cutright.note: DRAFT, not ratified: only Adrian's own words ratify a ruling. The checker ignores an amendment marked status proposed and the key proposedNotApplicable; on ratification Adrian's decision moves the rows to notApplicable and removes status. CutRight keeps both N/A strings, each carrying the issue and the expiry 2026-11-30.

proposedNotApplicable.M9: No SQLite app state. Project state is canonical JSON through rightkit-fs and settings are JSON through rightkit-app-settings; rightkit-db arrives only transitively through rightkit-job-queue and no JobStore is used.
proposedNotApplicable.M17: No first-party HTTP client. LLM calls go through rightkit-llm, speech through rightkit-speech-client, model packs through rightkit-models and licence through @rightkit/license; rightkit-http is transitive only.

viewright.source: bogusyogi/viewright RightKit port (branch claude/rk-port), independent verification
viewright.note: DRAFT, not ratified: only Adrian's own words ratify a ruling. The checker ignores an amendment marked status proposed and the key proposedNotApplicable. ViewRight keeps its N/A strings, each carrying the issue and the expiry 2026-11-30. M1 (#1067) and M22 (#994) are separate decisions and are not proposed here.

proposedNotApplicable.M3: No engine child process and no restart-surviving jobs: document open, save, export and OCR run in-process; the only child processes are reveal and open-with (rightkit-child-process) and the OCR worker (rightkit-ocr).
proposedNotApplicable.M4: No engine child process and no restart-surviving jobs: document open, save, export and OCR run in-process.
proposedNotApplicable.M7: No local service: rightkit-daemon is used for AppRoot and mode::roots only (M6 adopted), with no socket, pipe, discovery or claim file. The QA control server is rightkit-qa behind qa-native and dev-control.
